Our Zapier values →


Default to action

We believe in progress over perfection—delivering and learning from our projects sooner rather than later.

Default to transparency

We do our best work when we make projects, processes, and systems available to everyone who needs them.

Grow through feedback

Good feedback enables growth. It isn’t always easy, but we make a point to be good at it with peers and leaders.

Empathy over ego

Empathy promotes understanding, curiosity, and humility—qualities that help us connect with and serve our customers.

Build the robot

We’re all about finding ways to work better. We optimize for efficiency through tools, processes, and code.
